'''Elgerkab's Cantina''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ugnorgrad/Legends|Ugnorgrad]] on the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]]. It was the hangout for non-[[Ugnaught Mechanics Union|union]] members. It underwent major reconstruction after its fourth accidental fire in five years.<ref name="ActionTidings2" />
